Generate Person Deck Log/LOGMESSAGE: Generating a deck for -STR:Person-, using the variable name '-STR:Person- Deck'. Log/LOGMESSAGE: First take ten cards from the "bloat" list. Shuffle the bloat list and deal the first ten. These will be replaced as the deck levels up. Being first makes it replace first. SetList/-STR:Person- Deck ShuffleList/Template_Swordsman_Bloat ForLoop/-A-,0-9,1,AddToList,-STR:Person- Deck,LIST{Template_Swordsman_Bloat,-A-} Log/LOGMESSAGE: Take the "growth" list, and grab the first five and add it to the deck. ShuffleList/Template_Swordsman_Growth ForLoop/-A-,0-4,1,AddToList,-STR:Person- Deck,LIST{Template_Swordsman_Growth,-A-} Log/LOGMESSAGE: Take the next ten growth cards, and put it in the replace upgrade path. SetList/-STR:Person- Upgrade Replace With ForLoop/-A-,5-14,1,AddToList,-STR:Person- Upgrade Replace With,LIST{Template_Swordsman_Growth,-A-} Log/LOGMESSAGE: Finally put the "core" cards on the bottom SetVal/-STR:Person- Upgrade Index,=:0 ListToString/-STR:Person- Upgrade Replace With,;;,Replace With String Log/LOGMESSAGE: `-STR:Person- Replace With` is `-STR:Replace With String-` CombineLists/-STR:Person- Deck,Template_Swordsman_Start ListToString/-STR:Person- Deck,;;,Deck String Log/LOGMESSAGE: '-STR:Person- Deck' set to '-STR:Deck String-' SetList/-STR:Person- Ace,Template_Swordsman_Ace ListToString/-STR:Person- Ace,;;,Ace String Log/LOGMESSAGE: '-STR:Person- Ace' set to '-STR:Ace String-'
